annotation.justification: The target clause provides a clear and unambiguous requirement for servers to respond with a 400 (Bad Request) status code under specific conditions: (1) when an HTTP/1.1 request lacks a Host header field, (2) when it contains more than one Host header field, or (3) when the Host header field has an invalid field value. These conditions are well-defined and do not allow for multiple materially different interpretations. There is no missing constraint or undefined term that would lead to ambiguity in implementation.
